findings: Unbounded streaming buffer in BedrockAgentFieldDiscovery.discover() — no size cap on accumulated agent response chunks; add a max-bytes guard and rely on invoke_agent's idleSessionTTLInSeconds for timeout.

Lambda FunctionError not checked in LambdaFieldDiscovery.discover() — a Lambda execution error returns HTTP 200 with FunctionError set; Payload is parsed silently as a malformed dict, producing zero issues with no error raised. Check response.get('FunctionError') before parsing.

Greedy single-pass deduplication in deduplicate_issues is ordering-sensitive — cluster boundaries depend on list order, not semantic centrality. Sort by raw_count descending before the greedy pass to make survivor selection stable across pipeline runs.
